title: Retire the pre-cut-B work-authority revoke path
outcome: No live pre-cut-B work-authority revocation remains; original retired-grant history stays readable and passive, with no fabricated confirmation, hidden deletion, or gating of ordinary work.
acceptance: TermAl has no product path that runs engram authority revoke, retries that removed command, or requires a work-authority grant; its native command fixture rejects an attempted revoke.

Historical pre-cut-B retired-grant ledger entries, including revokeConfirmed:false, remain unchanged passive data across load and repeated boot. No revocation confirmation is invented and no retirement entry or original cleanup warning is silently removed; ordinary work is not gated on that history. The persisted shape and existing reader floor remain unchanged.

docs/features/host-architecture.md sections 2.7 and 5.3 accurately distinguish removal of work-authority revoke at 06bffb05 from later removal of turn gating, and describe the current passive-history contract without a live revoke command.

Behavioral tests cover loading and repeated boot of persisted retirement history, preservation of its fields and warning, and exactly-once ordinary prompt delivery without control/revoke invocation or retirement rewriting.
